observations: Standing gas cooker with a black finish.
Four gas burners on the top surface.
A single oven compartment below the cooktop.
A wooden-style handle on the oven door.
The unit is wrapped in clear plastic film.
The front control knobs are visible but the brand name is not legible in the photo.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrapping suggests it may be new or recently refurbished, but there is no photo showing the interior or the actual burners.
No photo shows the burners lit or the oven functioning.

risks.risk: Burners may be blocked, damaged, or not working.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit simultaneously.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or have a faulty thermostat.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven light on and the oven heating up.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may conceal scratches or deep scuffs on the exterior.
risks.proof: A photo of the unit with the plastic wrap removed.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of all four burners lit and the oven heating up.
Photo of the unit with the plastic wrap removed to check the exterior condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
